correctness.rationale: The ratio e-value is strictly increasing from an infimum of zero to a supremum of \(n+1\). Solving the strict wealth inequality gives exactly the stated all-space/finite-endpoint dichotomy. Differentiation gives a strictly negative endpoint derivative on the finite branch. The reserve equivalence follows from \(\inf_{v>0}W_\lambda(v)=W(1-\lambda)\). Boundary cases \(\lambda=0\), \(h=1+n\lambda\), and the strict next-batch threshold were checked explicitly.

value.rationale: The claim answers a concrete design question raised by the motivating paper: how fractional betting changes current batch informativeness. It identifies exactly when a finite score bound is possible, proves strict current-set monotonicity, and supplies a sharp reserve rule that guarantees the next batch remains capable of a bounded all-in set. This is a motivated structural tradeoff, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
